task: Check five sections, numerical evidence, and three independent Insight lines. Issue one retry per failing role at most.

sections.Overview:
Apple Inc. designs, manufactures, and markets smartphones, personal computers, tablets, wearables, and accessories, while also selling a variety of related services. The Company’s important product lines include iPhone (such as iPhone Duo™, iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max), Mac (including MacBook Neo®, MacBook Air®, MacBook Pro®, iMac®, Mac mini®, Mac Studio®), iPad (iPad Pro®, iPad Air®, iPad, iPad mini®), wearables (Apple Watch Series 12®, Apple Watch Ultra 4®, AirPods®, AirPods Pro®, AirPods Max®, Beats®), Apple Vision Pro® (spatial computer), and Apple TV 4K® (media streaming and gaming device) [10-K accession 0000320193-26-000026, lines L000851-L000915]. These devices run the Company’s proprietary operating systems iOS, macOS, iPadOS, watchOS, visionOS, and tvOS, delivering seamless integration and enabling a range of breakthrough services such as the App Store, Apple Music, Apple Pay, iCloud, and Apple TV [EX-99.1 accession 0000320193-26-000024, line L000019]. Apple’s fiscal year ends on the last Saturday of September [10-K accession L000853].

Insight: Despite broad macroeconomic headwinds, the Company’s investment in intangible assets increased notably in fiscal 2026 to $20.3 billion from $11.1 billion in 2025, revealing strategic emphasis on intellectual property and software development as a forward growth driver [10-K accession 0000320193-26-000026, lines L000091].
sections.Market Positioning and Growth Outlook: Apple holds a leading position in personal technology innovation with a diversified portfolio of hardware and integrated software platforms, which create high switching costs and a strong ecosystem. The Company highlights the outstanding lineup of iPhones including the iPhone Duo, described as the most transformational iPhone since the original, and the powerful new iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max [EX-99.1, L000013]. The active installed device base reached a new all-time high across all product categories, underscoring high customer satisfaction and loyalty [EX-99.1, L000014]. Growth is supported by revenue increases across Americas, Europe, Greater China, Japan, and Rest of Asia Pacific, driven primarily by higher iPhone, Services, and Mac net sales [10-K, L001238-L001253]. Specifically, iPhone net sales rose 21% in 2026 compared to 2025, reaching $254 billion [10-K, L001258], supported by new and refreshed models. Services, which include advertising and cloud services, recorded 13% net sales growth to $123 billion [10-K, L001262,L001275], reaching an all-time high in the September quarter [EX-99.1, L000009]. Mac and iPad sales also showed growth or stability, with Mac increasing 13% and iPad relatively flat [10-K, L001259, L001260]. The Company successfully navigates macroeconomic challenges, including inflation, tariffs, supply constraints, and currency fluctuations, which have imposed cost pressures and potential demand impacts [10-K, L001230-L001231, L001234].
sections.Valuation Insights:
Apple Inc. reported total revenue of $478.8 billion for fiscal year 2026 [C:revenue2026]. This represents a year-over-year growth of about 15.06% compared to $416.2 billion in fiscal 2025 [C:revenue_growth2026]. Operating income was $158.1 billion, yielding an operating margin of approximately 33.0% for the year [C:operating_income2026] [C:operating_margin2026]. Net income attributable to the company amounted to $132.2 billion [C:net_income2026], with GAAP diluted earnings per share of $8.98 [C:diluted_eps2026]. The return on average equity stood at about 142.3% [C:return_on_average_equity2026]. Debt to equity ratio, including the current portion of debt, was roughly 0.70 [C:debt_to_equity2026]. Free cash flow, calculated as operating cash flow less capital expenditures, was $136.1 billion [C:free_cash_flow2026].

For the latest quarter ended September 26, 2026, Apple posted revenue of $114.5 billion, up 12% year-over-year [C:latest_quarter_revenue]. The GAAP diluted EPS for this quarter was $2.10 [C:latest_quarter_eps]. Based on the closing stock price of $344.63 on October 30, 2026, the price-to-earnings ratio derived from fiscal 2026 GAAP diluted EPS is approximately 38.38 [C:pe_ratio].

In comparison to its peers, Apple's operating margin of 33.0% is below Microsoft Corp's 46.8% [C:msft_operating_margin], above Alphabet Inc.'s 32.0% [C:googl_operating_margin], and above Oracle Corp's 30.6% [C:orcl_operating_margin]. All peer operating margins are based on a consistent total-revenue definition.

Insight: Apple significantly increased its property, plant and equipment assets from $49.8 billion at the end of fiscal 2025 to $52.1 billion at fiscal 2026 year-end, indicating a substantial capital investment during the year. This is supported by the increase shown on the balance sheet in filing 10-K 0000320193-26-000026 at line 090 [C:pp&e].
sections.Future Developments and Strategic Recomm: Apple continues to invest heavily in research and development, with $45.8 billion spent in fiscal 2026, up from $34.6 billion in 2025, indicating a commitment to future innovation and product pipeline expansion [EX-99.1, L000047; 10-K, L001247]. Key product launches during fiscal 2026 included new iPhone models (iPhone Duo, iPhone 18 Pro/Max), MacBook Neo, MacBook Air, and MacBook Pro refreshes, AirPods Max 2, Apple Vision Pro, and new software versions of iOS, macOS, and other platforms [10-K, L001198-L001228]. Management should monitor tariff impacts and supply constraints especially for semiconductors, memory, and storage, as these represent material risks that could affect margins and volumes [10-K, L001230-L001231]. Strengthening the Services segment will be vital given its high-margin nature and recurring revenue model. Expanding Services and maintaining hardware innovation will likely sustain Apple’s competitive moat. Watching regional currency trends and geopolitical trade environments will also be critical for near-term planning and price adjustments.
sections.Investment Recommendation:
Hold provisional based on fiscal 2026 total revenue growth of 15.06% [C:revenue_growth2026].

Insight: Apple’s property, plant, and equipment assets increased to $52.1 billion at fiscal 2026 year-end, indicating sustained capital investment to support innovation and production capabilities [C:pp&e], 10-K 0000320193-26-000026, L000090.

Exhibit 99.1
Apple reports fourth quarter results
September quarter records for total company revenue, iPhone revenue, and EPS
Services revenue reaches new all-time high
CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA — Apple
®
today announced financial results for its fiscal 2026 fourth quarter ended September 26, 2026. The Company posted quarterly revenue of $114.5 billion, up 12 percent year over year. Company gross margin was 47.9 percent, including a favorable impact of approximately 1 percentage point from tariff refunds. Diluted earnings per share was $2.10, up 14 percent year over year, and included a favorable impact of $0.05 from tariff refunds.
“Today, Apple is proud to report a September quarter revenue record of $114.5 billion, up 12 percent from a year ago, with iPhone reaching a September quarter record and Services reaching an all-time high, capping off our best fiscal year ever,” said John Ternus, Apple’s CEO. “We’re closing the year with our most ambitious lineup yet. That includes the iPhone Duo, the most transformational iPhone since the original, alongside iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, our most powerful iPhones yet. We also just introduced a whole new generation of hardware for the home and brought Touch to Mac for the first time. Together with the all-new Siri AI, it’s an incredible lineup to carry us into the holiday season.”
“Apple delivered September quarter records for net income and EPS. Our record September quarter capped off a strong fiscal 2026, with all-time record revenue of $479 billion and double-digit EPS growth,” said Kevan Parekh, Apple’s CFO. “We generated $28 billion in operating cash flow during the quarter, allowing us to return $28 billion to shareholders. Thanks to our very high levels of customer satisfaction and loyalty, our installed base of active devices reached a new all-time high across all major product categories and geographic segments.”
Apple’s board of directors has declared a cash dividend of $0.27 per share of the Company’s common stock. The dividend is payable on November 16, 2026, to shareholders of record as of the close of business on November 12, 2026.
Apple will provide live streaming of its Q4 2026 financial results conference call beginning at 2:00 p.m. PT on November 2, 2026, at apple.com/investor/earnings-call. The webcast will be available for replay for approximately two weeks thereafter.
Apple periodically provides information for investors on its corporate website, apple.com, and its investor relations website, investor.apple.com. This includes press releases and other information about financial performance, reports filed or furnished with the SEC, information on corporate governance, and details related to its annual meeting of shareholders.
This press release contains forward-looking statements, within the meaning of the Private Securities Litigation Reform Act of 1995. These forward-looking statements include without limitation those about payment of the Company’s quarterly dividend and future business plans. These statements involve risks and uncertainties, and actual results may differ materially from any future results expressed or implied by the forward-looking statements. Risks and uncertainties include without limitation: effects of global and regional economic conditions, including as a result of government policies, trade and other international disputes, geopolitical tensions, conflict, terrorism, natural disasters, and public health issues; risks relating to the design, manufacture, introduction, and transition of products, services and technologies in highly competitive and rapidly changing markets, including from reliance on third parties for components, technology, manufacturing, applications, services, support, compute, storage, and content; risks relating to information technology system failures, network disruptions, and failure to protect, loss of, or unauthorized access to, or release of, data; and effects of unfavorable legal proceedings, government investigations, and complex and changing laws and regulations. More information on these risks and other potential factors that could affect the Company’s business, reputation, results of operations, financial condition, and stock price is included in the Company’s filings with the SEC, including in the “Risk Factors” and “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations” sections of the Company’s most recently filed periodic reports on Form 10-K and Form 10-Q and subsequent filings. The Company assumes no obligation to update any forward-looking statements, which speak only as of the date they are made.
Apple revolutionized personal technology with the introduction of the Macintosh in 1984. Today, Apple leads the world in innovation with iPhone, iPad, Mac, AirPods, Apple Watch, and Apple Vision Pro. Apple’s six software platforms — iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, visionOS, and tvOS — provide seamless experiences across all Apple devices and empower people with breakthrough services including the App Store, Apple Music, Apple Pay, iCloud, and Apple TV. Apple’s more than 150,000 employees are dedicated to making the best products on earth and to leaving the world better than we found it.
